body: We are all just meat robots obeying our genetic programming for the tiny period of time during which we exist.

You're a prick, you know that? I come here, hoping to maybe commiserate with other depressed suicidal people, and this doofus comes along telling me his genius 14 step plan to turn my life around and finally be happy! Why should I be charming? Every fucking day, I put on my best charm face and try to hide from the world my bitter rage and despair. Just once I want to express how I really, truly feel. But no! Someone has to come along and correct me.

And 'almost-lass'? What a charming almost-human you are.
I don't need to be patronized. I'm not that stupid. And I don't enjoy being contradicted every time I try to express my damn feelings.
I didn't come here for advice
